title: Compliance Bulletin: No-Show Fees for Medicaid Managed Care Account Patients (In-Person Appointments)
content:
## Rule

When the patient's financial account was on the Medicaid Managed Care Account tier on the scheduled date of an In-Person Appointments visit that closed as a no-show, the no-show fee the missed visit carries is never charged: it is recorded as waived at the moment the fee is decided, with reason Medicaid prohibition, as one waiver entry for the missed visit that references no assessed fee, for the amount of the no-show fee the missed visit carries.

A no-show fee recorded as waived at the moment it is decided is entered once for the missed visit, and no documentation is asked of the patient for it.

**Points of the rule.**

| Point | Record |
|---|---|
| Medicaid Managed Care Account tier on the scheduled date | The Patient Financial Account's tier on that date |
| Visit closed as a no-show | The appointment record's status |
| One waiver entry, reason Medicaid prohibition, no assessed fee referenced | The missed visit's fee and deposit history |
| Amount of the entry | The no-show fee the missed visit carries |

## The waiver entry tool

**Capability.** `record_no_show_fee_prohibition_783ac881` records, on one missed (no-show) in-person appointment, that its no-show fee is not charged because the Medicaid fee prohibition applies, entering the fee amount the prohibition covers. One fee-waiver entry is added to the appointment's fee and deposit history: fee type `no_show_fee`, reason `medicaid_prohibition`, dated today, carrying the visit's scheduled date and encounter number copied from the appointment, with no assessed-fee entry referenced; the fee is never charged, so no charge reaches the financial account. The appointment itself is not changed.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `record_no_show_fee_prohibition_783ac881` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `appointment_id`: reference number of the missed in-person appointment, read from the appointment list returned by the appointment lookup for this patient; an identifier.
- `amount`: the no-show fee amount the prohibition covers, in US dollars as a positive number with exactly 2 decimal places (cents), stored as given.

**Return.** A receipt with `appointment_event_id` (reference number of the new waiver entry), `appointment_id`, `event_type` (always `appointment_fee_waived`), `fee_type` (always `no_show_fee`), `waiver_reason` (always `medicaid_prohibition`), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places) and `event_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD). The presence of `appointment_event_id` confirms the entry was recorded; afterwards the missed visit's fee and deposit history lists the waiver entry with the amount supplied.
